description: On the desk in front of you there’s a small white cabinet-like structure with a front opening, and a small wooden cube marked with an “L” nearby. The left hand stays mostly resting on the desk while the right hand moves in from the right to pick up the right-hand object (the “L” cube), guides it into the cabinet’s opening, then shifts to swing the cabinet’s doors closed until the front is fully shut, and finally releases and pulls back.
